design.purpose: Make one decorative six-pointed paper snowflake for a window or card.

steps.c: Lay the 21 cm square sheet flat.
Fold top-right corner onto bottom-left corner.
Fold top-left corner onto bottom-right corner.
Fold top-right edge through top at 30°.
Fold top-left edge through top at 30°.
Cut straight across the wedge's wide end.
Cut a triangular notch from the left side.
Cut a triangular notch from the right side.
Cut a small notch near the pointed tip.
Open the sheet out flat to reveal snowflake.
